ios.desc:
Power your squat routine with AirUP, a motion-tracking coach built for AirPods. Enable precise rep counting, hit daily goals with live widgets, and stay motivated through streak calendars and weekly PR insights. AirPods are required to unlock motion detection. AirUP is a subscription experience; every annual membership starts with a 3-day free trial so you can test the full program before committing.

  Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
  Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/airuprepsprivacypolicy/home
  Disclaimer: AirPods and an active AirUP subscription are required to access
  motion tracking and all premium features.
